SCENE HEADING: INT WAREHOUSE — NIGHT

ACTION / DESCRIPTION:
INT. WAREHOUSE — NIGHT #102#

ZOYA
We have five minutes.

output.scene_summary: Inside a warehouse at night, Zoya urgently states that they only have five minutes remaining.

elements.name: ZOYA
elements.description: Speaking female lead character, delivers the line warning about the five-minute limit.

elements.name: Tactical Watch or Mobile Phone
elements.description: A timepiece or phone used by Zoya to track the remaining five minutes.

elements.name: Zoya's Night/Tactical Attire
elements.description: Dark or tactical clothing suitable for a stealthy night warehouse operation.

elements.name: Night Warehouse Lighting Setup
elements.description: Low-key, high-contrast night lighting, potentially utilizing practical overheads or moonlight shafts through windows.

elements.name: Warehouse Room Tone and Echo
elements.description: Acoustic environment setup to capture the natural reverb and hollow atmosphere of an empty warehouse.

elements.name: Warehouse Floor Clearance & Air Quality Check
elements.description: Inspection of the warehouse floor for tripping hazards, exposed wiring, and dust/mold levels before filming in low-light conditions.
elements.safety_notes: Ensure proper ventilation if dust is kicked up, and mark any uneven flooring with glow tape for crew safety.

stop_conditions: Airborne dust or hazardous particulate levels exceeding safe breathing thresholds inside the warehouse.
Total loss of safety/orientation lighting for crew members in the dark warehouse environment.
continuity_notes: Zoya's watch/timer must display a logical time consistent with the 'five minutes' dialogue.
Wardrobe and makeup must match the scenes immediately preceding and following this entry into the warehouse.
